Depth decode: node_modules/three/src/renderers/shaders/ShaderChunk/packing.glsl.js:21-31 writes R = top byte, G = middle byte, B = low byte (each times 256/255 then stored as a byte), A = fraction. So v = R/256 + G/65536 + B/16777216 + (A/255)/16777216. unpackDepth (line-art-pass.ts:122-129) is this formula. Bytes (255,255,255,255) decode to exactly 1.

viewDistance (line-art-pass.ts:42-44) is the inverse of the standard perspective depth d = far(z-near)/(z(far-near)). The song camera is a PerspectiveCamera(32, 1, 0.2, 120) (main.ts:46), and the renderer has no logarithmic or reversed depth buffer (main.ts:36). edgeData receives camera.near and camera.far (line-art-pass.ts:88).

Hand check: bytes [250,25,167,0] give depth 0.9769539 and 4.000 m with near 0.1 and far 50; bytes [250,140,49,0] give 4.300 m. diag.json (smoke diag-2026-10-25T23-00-20-478Z) records the same bytes, near 0.1, far 50, and distTrue 4.0000025 and 4.3000114.

T70 meaning: the normal pass is constant, so only the depth rule can mark the border. The absolute 0.02 rule on packed depth (gap 0.0035 at 4.0/4.3 m) fails the 4.0/4.3 ink case; a 0.5 percent gap must give no ink; column 0-3 must stay white. T76 meaning: an independent port of packDepthToRGBA with modf and byte rounding round-trips six depths within 1e-6, and the real GPU bytes give 4.0 m and 4.3 m within 0.01 m. A little-endian decode gives about 0.1003 m and fails both tests (Red 'Tests  2 failed | 88 passed (90)').

2 percent rule: isDepthEdge divides the gap by the nearer distance. 4.0/4.3 (7.5 percent) and 40/43 are edges; 4.0/4.02 and 40/40.2 (0.5 percent) are not. A floor gives a false edge only at grazing angles below about 2 degrees at a 0.0007 rad pixel pitch. Smoke run 3 lineart.png shows no floor noise band near the horizon.

Smoke run 3 evidence on disk: smoke.json has lineArtTechnique 'song-page-form-edges-viewdepth-1bit-v2', camera near 0.2 and far 120, and depthStep column 247, rows 88 to 246 (159 rows), which matches the label 'fixture depth step rows: 159/159'. fixture-lineart.png shows the circle and the vertical depth-step lines near column 247. Smoke run 2 failed with 0/159 on the same check, so the check fails when the depth edge is missing (A4).
The fixture depth-step planes both face +Z with MeshBasicMaterial geometry, so MeshNormalMaterial gives the same normal on both. The ink at column 247 can come only from the depth rule.
